reply.rationale: No defensible compositional paradigm is supported. Although all symbols are two-letter forms and some meanings are superficially suggestive (e.g. LI vs HI), there is no stable substitution frame where recurring parts make consistent, predictable contributions across multiple entries. Shared letter position alone is not evidence, and the meanings are largely idiosyncratic syndrome-like wholes rather than transparent combinations of reusable parts. Therefore the safest analysis is a flat lexicon.
